Package com.csse3200.game.encounters.integration

Class ChanceEncounterSession

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.encounters.integration.ChanceEncounterSession
public final class ChanceEncounterSession extends Object
Coordinates choice resolution, player updates, and map completion for one Chance Encounter.

    • ChanceEncounterSession

      public ChanceEncounterSession(Integer nodeId, ChanceEncounter encounter, ChanceOutcomeApplier outcomeApplier, EncounterCallback completionCallback)
      Creates one Chance Encounter lifecycle session.
      Parameters:
      nodeId - map node that launched the encounter
      encounter - Chance Encounter definition
      outcomeApplier - service applying the selected outcome to the player
      completionCallback - callback returning control to the map
